scope: Evaluation-only one-pass GT correction directions; not an optimized upper bound, learned output, uncertainty calibration, or change to B5. Overlapping active crops are pooled for an operator energy diagnostic, not independent samples. H and S include weighted blending and outer far-null and are not both orthogonal projectors.
hard_filter: N_far [weighted average of embedded P_near(N_far error)_crop P_near^T] then N_far
spatial_filter: Same actual weights/count/support and far-null, removing only P_near.
